title: Cosmic Grim Reaper
description: A skeletal Grim Reaper in a hooded dark robe stands in a wooden Viking-style boat atop a mossy rocky outcrop. A large pink tentacled alien creature with big green eyes hovers beside him, its tentacles draping over the boat and rock, set against a swirling green and blue cosmic vortex sky with stars, clouds, and a glowing spiral galaxy.
prompt: A skeletal grim reaper wearing a dark hooded robe stands in an ornate wooden Viking longboat perched on a moss-covered rocky cliff. Next to him floats a large pink octopus-like alien creature with large green eyes and long dripping tentacles that wrap around the boat and rock. The background features a dramatic swirling green and blue cosmic vortex with a bright central light, stars, clouds, and a glowing spiral galaxy in the sky, with a small bat flying nearby, in a vibrant fantasy surreal style.
